messages:
Marcus: Heads-up — noticed some inconsistencies across SDK snippets: camelCase params in JS docs but snake_case in Python examples. Can we pick a canonical casing for param names (e.g., role_name vs roleName)?
Anya: definitely agree. prefer snake_case for SDKs? we use snake_case in python but js usually camelCase. our docs should show both with clear migration notes.
Marcus: my concern is naming for 'system_prompt' vs 'systemPrompt' — affects our migration guide and search/replace scripts. Also found a broken link in the migration guide pointing to /sdk/v1/old-params
Zahra: +1 to explicitly document both patterns. propose we add a short "Param casing" section in the migration guide and include copy-paste snippets for each SDK.
Kevin: I added a draft snippet in the PR — see code
```
# python migration example
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="redwood-13b", system_prompt="You are a helpful assistant", max_tokens=256)
```
Luca: That looks good, but we should use the new param name `system_message` (we renamed it last sprint). Also reference deprecation header.
Marcus: oh right — we renamed. need to update all instances. I'll sweep the repo and open PRs.
docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck passed, 3 warnings (titles)
Anya: for voice/tone: keep "assistant" not "bot" in docs text. Small note: avoid "just" and "simply" in examples.
Zahra: I'll update the glossary entry for `system_message` -> include previous names: `system_prompt`, `systemPrompt`. Also add redirect links.
Marcus: timeline — I'll do the repo sweep today, open PRs for SDK snippets and migration guide updates. can someone review #4321?
Kevin: happy to review after lunch :thumbsup:
Luca: I'll add a short section on "Finding param mappings" in the migration guide with a table and a script snippet to map names.
Marcus: thanks — can we also add an automated linter rule in docs CI to flag legacy param names? saves manual work.
Zahra: good idea — filed ticket DOCS-198
Marcus: ok thanks team. i'll post PR links when ready.
Anya: great, ping here when PRs are up :rocket:
